title: Module dependencies in the module list
asked: Backfilled from CLAUDE.md Status (built before builds reported themselves).

result.summary: `listModules()` (engine-rpc `modules`, console `GET /api/modules`) now gives each module `dependsOn` = the module names its `build.gradle.kts` pulls in with `project(":x")`; libraries already carry `dependsOn` in `libraries.json`. Build Pilot uses both to highlight what a picked feature needs.
